links.outcome: Faithfulness and retrieval accuracy of RAG-grounded LLM answers
links.effect: Recursive chunking with fine-tuned GTE-Large reached retrieval accuracy 0.9; query expansion raised semantic chunking accuracy from 0.75 to 0.85; faithfulness at least 0.9.

unlisted_practices: Defining a causal structure and medical idioms for the LLM to follow in Bayesian network modelling
Fine-tuning the embedding model and optimising chunking and query expansion for retrieval

screen.reason: Evaluates a newly developed LLM-RAG pipeline tool for clinical decision support Bayesian network modelling via a clinician user study assessing workload and accuracy.
